name: openkt
description: OpenKT (Open Knowledge Transfer) — persistent memory + context layer for Claude Code agents. Captures decisions, anti-patterns, and non-obvious project facts across sessions; auto-injects relevant memories on every prompt.

install.before: kt --version || (echo 'kt CLI not installed — run: curl -fsSL https://openkt.ai/install.sh | sh' >&2 && exit 1)
install.after: kt doctor --json || echo 'kt doctor reported issues; run `kt login` if you haven\'t already'
